description: Replay <repo>/rust/app-cases/ against a build (the original, the front door, the final Rust binary): passed/total, fallback rate when the build reports it, and a report with a diff per failing case (rust/app-cases/replay-report.md).

build.description: Command line of the build to test; the original when omitted.

case.description: Replay only this case, by the name the report gives it (a library: only this unit): the fast loop for fixing one mismatch.

port.description: Servers: the port the build always listens on; otherwise it gets a free one through PORT and {port}.

timeout.description: Seconds before a run is killed (default 30).

name: app_replay
title: Replay app cases
